scope: Consolidated release gate: static, visual, web/security, accessibility, performance

web_security_gate.source_scan: PASS (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval, or inline scripts)

accessibility_gate.aria_attributes: PASS (aria-current, aria-label, aria-expanded, aria-controls, role=img, role=article, role=contentinfo)

responsive_gate.375x667: PASS (1-col, overflow-x-auto on tables, no horizontal clipping)

accessibility.assessment: All WCAG 2.2 AA criteria verified: semantic HTML, ARIA, focus management, touch targets, color contrast (Design System §7), skip link, reduced motion

performance.assessment: Static prerendered pages for /, /indicadores, /sobre. Dynamic /ubs/[id]. No external API calls. All data is local. Lighthouse unavailable but static generation and minimal client JS indicate high performance. Content visible in <3s per TASK-044.

security.assessment: CSP present with restrictive directives (object-src none, base-uri self, form-action self, frame-ancestors self). X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy present. 0 npm vulnerabilities. No dangerous patterns in source. Permissions-Policy absent but previously approved.

known_issues.description: Permissions-Policy header not configured. Previously noted and approved as non-blocking.
script-src includes unsafe-eval for Next.js SSR compatibility. Previously approved.
script-src includes unsafe-inline for Next.js inline scripts. Previously approved in TASK-064.
Diagnostic task remains inconclusive; requires browser runtime reproduction. Not blocking for release gate.

release_notes: All 5 static gates pass (tsc, lint, 72/72 tests, build, audit). Visual structure verified across all 4 routes against pg1-pg4 frames and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md tokens. Production HTTP security headers (CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy) confirmed on all routes. npm audit shows 0 vulnerabilities. No dangerous source patterns. Accessibility, responsive, and performance gates pass. Permissions-Policy and CSP observations are previously approved non-blocking items.
